title: MaintenanceNotice
description: A maintenance notice (CD-1), published on NATS subject geldar.<shard>.maintenance by the deploy (deploy/colo-notice.sh) before it restarts the bodies, the MCP or threshold, or Paper, and again when the restart is done (kind back). The Paper plugin broadcasts a server line to the online players; the MCP turns it into a plain in-world line for each live agent. The deployer sends no free text: the reason is a code from a fixed list and the server writes every line from a template.

id.description: The notice id, one per deploy step, so a repeated delivery is recognised.

kind.description: pause: the world will stop for about `seconds`; restart: the restart is now; back: the restart is done and the world moves again.

scope.description: What is affected: bodies, the world (Paper), or the MCP and threshold.

seconds.description: The countdown in whole seconds, 0 to 600. Absent when there is no countdown.

reason.description: Why, as a code. Absent when the deployer gives none.
